title: Out-parameters and pointer-to-pointer
summary: Return a status, deliver results through pointers; change which object a pointer points at.
hints: Inside `divide_paise`, `*share = amount / parts;` writes into the caller's variable. Check the invalid cases first and return -1 before writing anything.
`point_at_bigger` receives the address of the caller's pointer. Assigning `*biggest = a;` changes what the caller's pointer points at.
Draw the memory table from module 1.05: `bigger` lives in main's frame, and `biggest` holds its address.
